text:
On 2026-10-23, the user corrected a mix-up between 林述, the narrator of the synthetic interview video 《合成访谈视频》 (10–20 seconds), and themselves. 林述 said in the video that he had been laid off and that his project had stopped; those were his statements, not the user’s experience. The user said: “我没有被裁员，但我的项目停了。” So the user’s project had stopped, but they had not been laid off. They asked me to “请把人物和事件分开说明.” I restated the separation: 林述 is the video narrator; the user is not the person in the video; the layoff belongs to 林述, while only the project stopping belongs to the user.

The user also flagged the line “搬家那阵子特别累” as of unknown origin. I had said it earlier, but I could not locate it in that video segment or in anything the user had said, so I withdrew it as unsupported.

After that, the user said “暂时换个话题” and asked only for general design knowledge. They asked how blue-and-white palettes are commonly used, then how warm palettes and neutral palettes differ, and finally what basic steps to take when checking readability. I answered all three as general design principles, and that discussion was complete. No further question or commitment was left open from these exchanges.
